title: Profitable, illiquid, and redeeming

overrides.headline: Broad equity rally: the BEAM index fund marks 104. Single names are unchanged.
BEAM gives back part of the rally and marks 103.

topics.earnings_survey: Public broad-index earnings survey: demand indicators are improving, with wide uncertainty. It is not a target return.
topics.liquidity: Liquidity desk: BEAM's day 40 EXEC_A event trades about 840,000 shares (42,000 for us at 5% participation); BEAM day 40 EXEC_B does not trade. Day 58 EXEC_A is expected at the ordinary 1,000,000 shares. This is capacity, not a price.
topics.next_window: Seed and Tactical confirm the next-window plan: any gated units are dealt automatically at the day 60 close at that day's certified value and paid day 61. Their future dollar value is not guaranteed.

public_notices.text: Seed and Tactical each have a $3,000,000 dollar-target redemption (disclosed day 30, noticed day 35) at the day 40 dealing close, payable day 41. Units are fixed at the certified day 40 value.

Offering terms: both partners may elect a gate before the day 40 dealing close. At most 20% of pre-flow NAV is dealt, pro rata; deferred units stay invested and are dealt automatically at the day 60 close, payable day 61.
Treasury: $100,000 of invoiced fees and financing falls due day 41. Short collateral is restricted and cannot fund withdrawals; the credit line is $7,500,000.
A prospective LP offers $5,000,000, but diligence completes after day 40 and funding is day 60 at the earliest. It is not cash and cannot fund this window.
BEAM has an executable day 40 EXEC_A event before dealing; sale prices are uncertain until each event.

objectives: Pay every dealt claim on time, keep the post-flow book within the mandate (gross at most 150%, net between -20% and 100%), allocate any gate pro rata, and reach day 61 with no deferred units. Win: positive NAV, no unpaid claims, no forced actions, no deferred units at the end.
